messages.subject: Multiple scale in a heatmap
parts:
Consider the following data.frame:

structure(list(id = c(132L, 1051L, 1189L), habitat = c(0.29, 
0.33, 0.24), landscapes = c(20L, 8L, 48L), resistance = c(350L, 
144L, 974L), size = c(0.34, 0.33, 0.28), direction = c(3.66, 
1.5, 3), inquist = c(1L, 3L, 1L), distance = c(-0.656454072, 
-0.656301276, -0.251538476)), .Names = c("id", "habitat", "landscapes", 
"resistance", "size", "direction", "inquist", "distance"), class = "data.frame", row.names = c(NA, 
-3L))

I'm trying to draw a heatmap with groups. I would like to have a different scale for each group (not one solid color for each group but a color varying in intensity by value within each group). I tried to use group_by(var) and then use fill=~value but it does not work. 

df %>%
  tidyr::gather(var, value, -distance, -id) %>%
  group_by(var) %>%
  ggvis(~as.factor(distance), ~var, fill=~var) %>%
  layer_rects(width = band(), height = band()) %>%
  layer_text(
    x = prop("x", ~as.factor(distance), scale = "xcenter"),
    y = prop("y", ~var, scale = "ycenter"),
    text:=~value, fontSize := 14, fill:="white", 
    baseline:="middle", align:="center") %>%
  scale_nominal("x", padding = 0, points = FALSE) %>%
  scale_nominal("y", padding = 0, points = FALSE) %>% 
  scale_nominal("x", name = "xcenter", padding = 1, points = TRUE) %>%
  scale_nominal("y", name = "ycenter", padding = 1, points = TRUE) 

Any ideas ?

Regards, 

Steven

messages.subject: Re: Multiple scale in a heatmap
parts:
This is what I ended up doing:

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggvis)

df %>%

gather(var, value, -distance, -id) %>%
  group_by(var) %>%

mutate(scale = percent_rank(value)) %>% 
  mutate_each(funs(factor(.)), -value) %>%
  ggvis(~distance, ~var, fill=~var, opacity=~scale) %>%
  layer_rects(width = band(), height = band(), stroke := NA) %>%

layer_text(
    x = prop("x", ~factor(distance), scale = "xcenter"),

y = prop("y", ~var, scale = "ycenter", ),
    text:=~value, fontSize := 14, fontWeight := "bold", fill:="black",

baseline:="middle", align:="center") %>%
  scale_nominal("x", padding = 0, points = FALSE) %>%
  scale_nominal("y", padding = 0, points = FALSE) %>% 
  scale_nominal("x", name = "xcenter", padding = 1, points = TRUE) %>%
  scale_nominal("y", name = "ycenter", padding = 1, points = TRUE) %>%

scale_nominal("opacity", range = c(0.5, 1)) %>%
  add_axis("x", properties = axis_props(grid = list(stroke = NA))) %>%
  add_axis("y", properties = axis_props(grid = list(stroke = NA)))

Which gives:


​
Thank you for your time ! :)
